basis: HD-ZIP IV (OCL/ML1 clade) L1-identity TF; L1-restricted by Molecular Cartography in the W3.5 spike (17.1% of MC cells) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). The vSAM section of the same study agrees (same study, not counted as independent).
HD-ZIP IV (PDF2-like) L1 TF; top DE gene of L1 cluster 7 (pct 0.87 vs 0.23) and L1-restricted by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Single study.
HD-ZIP IV (HDG11-like); L1-restricted by Molecular Cartography (3.0% of MC cells) and DE in L1 cluster 7 (0.28 vs 0.06) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
PDR-type ABC transporter (cuticle-export family); L1-restricted by Molecular Cartography (24.4% of MC cells); DE in L1-FM cluster 1 (0.36 vs 0.16) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

PROTODERMAL FACTOR1-like; DE in L1 cluster 7 (0.66 vs 0.14) and vSAM tunica (Supp Tables 7, 10) but no in situ. Conflict: also a Supp Table 13 Xylem subcluster marker (0.31 vs 0.006) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

LONELY GUY cytokinin-activating enzyme; L1 cells at meristem tips by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants) and by in situ in L1 of IM and triple-mound meristems (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS); two independent studies. ID link to Zhong via Demesa Supp Table 4.

HD-ZIP IV (HDG1-like); apical L1 of IM/SM/FM and leaf founder cells by Molecular Cartography (17.8% of MC cells) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants); meristem-enriched in laser-microdissected meristems (Thiel et al. 2021 Sci Adv; tissue-level, not counted).

Class I KNOX (KN1/STM ortholog) for meristem maintenance; non-L1 corpus cells of IM/TSM by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants) and by in situ (non-L1 IM and TMM; Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS). Broad (64.5% of MC cells); absent from L1 and organ primordia.

WUSCHEL ortholog (organizing centre by function in grasses); in the MC panel but not detected and not a cluster marker (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Find WUS1+ cells by expression; expect very few.

LOFSEP MADS (OsMADS34/PAP2 ortholog); paper lists it for IM/TSM, MC 53.5% of cells (broad). Conflict: scRNA DE in green-rachis cluster 21 (0.36 vs 0.10) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants); broad in VM-to-floral organs (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS).

FLORICAULA/LEAFY ortholog; paper lists IM/TSM, but MC detects it in 55.5% of cells (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants) and in situ shows broad SM, FM and floral-organ expression (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS). Not specific.

AP2-like TF required for IM indeterminacy (int-m mutant); in situ broad in IM, TMM and SM, later lemma/palea/rachilla (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS); MC 53.3% of cells (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Broad in both studies. Repressed by protoplasting (Supp Table 2, log2FC -3.3).

LOB-domain RAMOSA2 ortholog controlling spikelet determinacy and row type (vrs4 mutant; in situ in Koppolu et al. 2013 PNAS, pattern not re-checked here); TSM founder cells, glume/lateral-spikelet domain by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

HD-ZIP I TF suppressing lateral-spikelet fertility; in situ strictly in lateral-spikelet primordia (Komatsuda et al. 2007 PNAS). Barley/Triticeae-specific. Not in MC panel or cluster DE; repressed by protoplasting (Supp Table 2, log2FC -3.4). Morex reference carries the six-rowed vrs1 allele (divergent C-terminus); Golden Promise is two-rowed.

Grass-specific TCP (BAD1/WAB1 clade) in the IM-to-SM boundary at the base of forming SMs, by in situ (Poursarebani et al. 2020 Nat Commun) and by Molecular Cartography at spikelet boundary/rachilla (9.2% of MC cells) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants); com1 mutant branches. Also in palea (Poursarebani 2020).

COM1 marks the rachilla primordium by Molecular Cartography and defines corpus subcluster 16 (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Single study for the rachilla call; also a boundary marker (see Organ_Boundary).

GATA TF orthologous to maize TSH1 and rice NL1 that suppresses the inflorescence bract (Whipple et al. 2010 Plant Cell; trd mutant). No expression support in Demesa-Arevalo 2026 (Supp Table 4 only), and repressed by protoplasting (Supp Table 2, log2FC -3.3).

YABBY CRABS CLAW/DROOPING LEAF ortholog; leaf and suppressed-bract founder cells, then the abaxial FM domain that forms the lemma, by Molecular Cartography (7.7% of MC cells) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Bract-like organs in general, not one organ.

AGL6 MADS (OsMADS6 ortholog; floral meristem/palea/lodicule identity in rice); FM centre by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants) and by in situ at W3.x (Kuijer et al. 2021 Front Plant Sci; also palea and lodicules later). Same gene by Morex V1 ID (HORVU6Hr1G066140) in both.

LOFSEP MADS (OsMADS1/LHS1 ortholog) for lemma/palea identity; lemma primordium and FM by in situ (Kuijer et al. 2021 Front Plant Sci), SM then lemma/palea by in situ (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS), Molecular Cartography and lemma corpus subcluster 4 (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Not in glumes. Also palea: pair with HvCRC (abaxial lemma).

B-class AP3/DEF MADS; in situ first in stamen and lodicule primordia at W3.5, absent in mov1 mutant (Selva et al. 2023 J Exp Bot); top DE gene of FM/floral-organ cluster 4 (0.87 vs 0.23) and stamen corpus subclusters (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Also lodicule: use with AG-class genes to separate.

B-class PI/GLO MADS; DE in cluster 4 (0.39 vs 0.09) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Conflict: in situ in most floral organs early (glumes, lodicules, stamens, carpel) at W3.5-W6 (Selva et al. 2023 J Exp Bot).
B-class PI/GLO MADS; stamen primordia by Molecular Cartography (3.2% of MC cells) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Later in carpel apex and lodicules (Selva et al. 2023 J Exp Bot).

C-class AG MADS; stamen and gynoecium primordia by Molecular Cartography (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants) and in situ in stamens and pistils (Zhong et al. 2021 PNAS). Conflict: confined to ovules at W6 (Selva et al. 2023 J Exp Bot); also a top DE gene of L1 cluster 7 (0.61 vs 0.12).

C-class AG MADS; strong carpel expression in dissected organs, marginal for HvMADS3 (Kuijer et al. 2021 Front Plant Sci); in the MC panel (2.4% of cells) but its pattern is not described (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Carpel initiates around W3.5, so few cells.
D-class MADS (OsMADS13/STK ortholog); in situ confined to the ovule (Selva et al. 2023 J Exp Bot). Ovules form after W3.5: not expected in a W3.5 sample.

MANY-NODED DWARF GNAT acetyltransferase; restricted by Molecular Cartography (10.7% of MC cells) and DE in rachis "pith" cluster 14 (lfc 4.2, 0.35 vs 0.03) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). The paper calls it vascular; the cluster is rachis ground tissue.

PXY/TDR receptor kinase ortholog (procambium in Arabidopsis); listed as a cambium marker (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants Supp Table 4) but not a subcluster DE gene and no in situ. Ortholog function only.
WOX4 ortholog (procambium in Arabidopsis); in the MC panel but not detected (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Ortholog function only.
Class III HD-ZIP (ATHB8/ATHB15 clade; procambium/xylem precursor). The paper lists it as xylem (Supp Table 4); not a subcluster DE gene, no in situ (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

VND NAC TF ortholog (xylem vessel differentiation); DE in the Xylem vascular subcluster (0.42 vs 0.02, Supp Table 13) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). Also DE in FM-centre cells (Supp Table 19). No in situ.
CLE peptide (FOS1); Xylem vascular subcluster marker; in the MC panel but not detected (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT MYB ortholog (phloem identity); DE in the Phloem vascular subcluster (0.52 vs 0.004, Supp Table 13) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants). No in situ.
SMXL3 ortholog (protophloem formation in Arabidopsis); listed as phloem marker (Supp Table 4) but not a subcluster DE gene, no in situ (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).

SUT1-clade sucrose transporter: the protein matches HvSUT1 (UniProt Q9M422, 521/523 residues). The paper calls it "HvSUC2" and UniProt names it "SUT3". Grass SUT1 loads phloem in companion cells. Strongly induced by protoplasting (Supp Table 2, log2FC +5.1), so unreliable in protoplast data (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
Replication-dependent histone H4; DE in S-phase cluster 5 (0.85 vs 0.23) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
Replication-dependent histone H4; DE in S-phase cluster 5 (0.79 vs 0.17) and vSAM cycling cluster (Supp Table 7) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
Replication-dependent histone H3; DE in S-phase cluster 5 (0.54 vs 0.10) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
B-type CDK (G2/M); DE in G2 cluster 23 (0.76 vs 0.15) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
A-type cyclin (G2); DE in G2 cluster 23 (0.74 vs 0.07) and the vSAM cycling cluster (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
A3-type cyclin; patchy in the Molecular Cartography section (15.4% of MC cells) and DE in S cluster 13 (0.37 vs 0.07) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
TANGLED1 (division-plane / preprophase band protein); DE in M-phase cluster 12 (0.32 vs 0.02) (Demesa-Arevalo et al. 2026 Nat Plants).
